versions.changelog: v0.2.0: Preserve last 10 raw messages verbatim for exact conversation resumption. Two-layer continuity: AI summary + raw interactions. Loads today + yesterday on session start. Configurable MAX_RECENT_MESSAGES and MAX_SUMMARY_CHARS.

v1.1.0: Preserve last 10 raw messages verbatim for exact conversation resumption. Two-layer continuity: AI summary + raw interactions. Loads today + yesterday on session start. Configurable MAX_RECENT_MESSAGES and MAX_SUMMARY_CHARS.

- Renamed skill from session-memory to session-context for clarity and consistency.
- Updated documentation: revised install instructions, repository URLs, and usage guidance for the new skill name.
- Removed obsolete script, example, and reference files for a leaner codebase and easier maintenance.

- Added AGENTS.md file for documentation or configuration.
- Removed handler.js and handler.ts from hooks/openclaw, streamlining the codebase.

session-context v0.1.1

- Documentation updates made in README.md and metadata for clarity.
- No functional or code changes; behavior remains the same.

- Introduces session continuity by loading recent conversation memory at session start.
- Automatically generates and saves AI-powered conversation summaries during compaction to maintain context across sessions.
- No manual steps required; integrates with OpenClaw hooks for seamless automation.
- Customizable thresholds for when to summarize and how much memory to load.
- Requires OpenClaw version 0.29.0 or newer.
